# Class `testexport`

Based on the testimage class, the testexport class can be used to export the test environment outside of the OpenEmbedded Build System. This will generate the directory structure to execute the runtime tests using the runexported.py Python script.

For more details on how to use testexport, see the Exporting Tests section in the Yocto Project Test Environment Manual.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/classes.html#ref-classes-testexport
